calls.reason: SWE-CI reports better scores for newer models. GAO traces the fatal Dhahran defense failure to a software calculation problem, supporting the general claim that a few critical software errors can be deadly.
SWE-CI cites maintenance's large lifecycle cost share and reports agent regressions. Neither directly establishes that maintenance is generally harder than writing or debugging code.

The EASE study finds humans perform about 83% of maintenance on the AI-generated files studied. That supports current human involvement, but months of evidence cannot settle a forecast extending far into the future.

FT reports internal documents linking incidents to AI-assisted changes; Amazon disputes that account while acknowledging one AI-advice incident. The packet does not establish the scale of the specifically AI-linked harm.
